title: Circuit query and family language equivalence
statement: Let $F$ be a family of Boolean circuits such that every circuit in the family has fan-in at most two, and let $y,e$ be binary strings. The pair encoding of $y$ and $e$ belongs to the language accepted by $F$ if and only if the query formed from the encoding of the circuit $F$ on inputs of length $|\langle y,e\rangle|$, together with $y$ and $e$, belongs to the circuit-value language.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in the family $F$ has fan-in at most two
